raw_text: Hazmat is an open-source tool that runs AI coding agents inside a separate account on your own machine. raw_text: DOVER, Del., Aug. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- MoonRush has launched its social trading app for crypto markets, bringing token discovery, trader and wallet tracking, on-chain market data, social features and AI-powered risk protection into a mobile experience.
